title: 十三张单墩失利提示动画关键帧
intendedUse: 4×4 序列关键帧图集，裁成 16 帧后输出透明 AVIF 与 Pixi 帧序列，用于单墩失利的克制提示
prompt: Create an exact 4-column by 4-row transparent sprite sheet of 16 sequential animation frames for a premium Shisanshui card game. Animate a gentle loss cue with a cool emerald and ivory ring: frame 1 a small soft glint, frames 2-5 a compact ring appears and contracts slightly, frames 6-9 a few dim teal sparks drift down, frames 10-13 particles gently fade, frames 14-16 return to fully transparent. Keep the effect centered in every equal square cell, same scale and pivot, with no motion crossing cell boundaries. Transparent background. Keep the mood calm, clear and non-punitive; this is a small comparison indicator, not a full-screen defeat scene. All wording and score are rendered by the game.
negativePrompt: text, letters, numbers, score, labels, panels, cards, suit symbols, characters, background, grid lines, gutters, borders, effects touching neighboring cells, changing camera, inconsistent pivots, red alarm, skulls, damage, explosions, harsh bloom, photorealism, watermark, logo

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Use only as the existing particle material and palette reference; create the described calm loss cue.
